Discussions around antibody validation in biomedical research continue to intensify. OSC member Johan Duchêne recently published a comment highlighting the need for validation and the implications of unreliable antibodies for reproducibility.
To ensure reliable and reproducible findings, this piece proposes to establish a standardized, community-wide framework that distributes validation responsibilities across researchers, manufacturers, and publishers.
[Johan Duchêne](/people/people/johan-duchene.qmd) advocates for centralized, open-access repositories where individual laboratories publish both positive and negative antibody validation outcomes to eliminate redundant testing.

## Read the commentary here:

Duchêne, J. (2026). Better antibodies, better science. PLOS Biology, 24(10), Article e3004001. [https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3004001](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3004001)
